# robinhood-chain-connect

> Wallet + onboarding kit for Robinhood Chain dApps: one component for "add network → fund via bridge → connect" (no wagmi connector kit exists yet).

robinhood-chain-connect is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/robinhood-chain-connect/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
